summary: John's 4th-great-grand-aunt (sister of Mary Connole); mother of Dr. Thomas J. Dailey.
bio: Honora 'Nora' Connole was born in Plymouth Township in 1855 (per her son's biography; FamilySearch: Jun 1856) and died 3 Oct 1910. She married William Dailey (b. Schuylkill Co. 1851). Her 1855 Plymouth birth is the main evidence that the Connoles reached Plymouth well before Mary's obituary's '1865'.
sources: Harvey & Smith vol. VI, T. J. Dailey sketch p.~422: https://archive.org/details/historyofwilkesb06harv

Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
